nodes.label: One Task Per Coherent Result
nodes.rationale: Continue the same task for the same bug with new logs, start a new one for an independent topic, and hand off a long mixed task. There is no fixed message count that forces a switch; the goal is a manageable context per coherent result.

nodes.label: Handoff Template
nodes.rationale: A handoff states goal, actually implemented state, relevant files, decisions, open defects, last checks and exact log paths, separating confirmed findings from assumptions and linking existing feature docs instead of repeating the whole history. Not every chat belongs in the central handoff.

nodes.label: Dungeon Bug Report Guidance
nodes.rationale: Name the installed version, floor, run phase and room and describe an observable difference rather than a vague symptom; use the room data command instead of guessing names from similar looks, and save a trace immediately after the defect.
